entries.070479f8c7444871: This business develops, manufactures and sells printing-related equipment and provides maintenance services. SCREEN Graphic Solutions Co., Ltd. is in charge of it; domestic sales are handled by SCREEN GP Japan Co., Ltd., maintenance services by SCREEN GP Service East Japan Co., Ltd. and SCREEN GP Service West Japan Co., Ltd., and overseas operations by SCREEN GP Americas, LLC (U.S.), SCREEN GP Europe B.V. (Netherlands), SCREEN GA Shanghai Co., Ltd. (China) and SCREEN GP Australia PTY., Ltd. (Australia). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥57,347 million and segment profit was ¥3,602 million, making it the second-largest business after SPE. The number of employees is 890. The company explains that revenue increased because of higher sales of equipment and recurring business centered on ink (revenue that recurs after delivery), but profit declined due to higher fixed costs and the impact of U.S. tariffs.
entries.08b0eb170c91db3b: In October 2014 it moved to a holding company structure and changed its company name from Dainippon Screen Mfg. Co., Ltd. to SCREEN Holdings Co., Ltd. At the same time, it had SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions Co., Ltd. succeed to the semiconductor production equipment business, and in November of the following month it had SCREEN Graphic and Precision Solutions Co., Ltd. succeed to the printing-related equipment and printed circuit board-related equipment businesses, and SCREEN Finetech Solutions Co., Ltd. succeed to the FPD equipment business and other equipment-related businesses. In April 2017 it had SCREEN PE Solutions Co., Ltd. succeed to the printed circuit board-related equipment business from the former, and the remaining company changed its company name to SCREEN Graphic Solutions Co., Ltd. As a forerunner of the spin-offs, in July 2002 it split off the domestic sales division for printing-related equipment and established Media Technology Japan Co., Ltd. (now SCREEN GP Japan Co., Ltd.).

The core company, SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions Co., Ltd., by itself as 1 company had net sales of ¥448,468 million, exceeding 10% of consolidated net sales, so the annual securities report discloses its profit and loss individually (ordinary profit of ¥110,387 million and net profit of ¥81,884 million). In the same year, sales decreased and profit decreased because, while post-sales (sales of maintenance, parts, and other products after delivery) and sales of equipment for DRAM increased, sales of equipment for foundries decreased, and by region, sales to Taiwan increased while sales to China and the United States decreased. entries.fc0f9017efe6642f: On October 11, 1943, Dainippon Screen Mfg. Co., Ltd. was established with capital of ¥130,000 and its head office was placed in Kyoto City. From March 1946 it began production of photographic platemaking machinery such as cameras, arc lamps and printing-down frames, and started out as a comprehensive manufacturer of photographic platemaking equipment. In June 1953 it acquired the Horikawa Plant, which is the current head office location. Its shares were listed on the Second Section of the Osaka Securities Exchange in May 1962 and on the Second Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in October 1967, were redesignated to the First Section of both exchanges in August 1970, and moved to the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in the market segment revision in April 2022.
